//: DS Platform STAGE slot — Centrifugo v6 config, one instance per slot (#2064, tech spec 2026-09-08 §3 «Slots»). NON-SECRET, SLOT-AGNOSTIC shape only: one committed file serves `main` and every `pr-<N>`.
//secrets: Injected as env vars from /etc/ds-platform/stage.env via compose `environment:` under Centrifugo's native names: CENTRIFUGO_HTTP_API_KEY (= the api's CENTRIFUGO_API_KEY) and CENTRIFUGO_CLIENT_TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET_KEY (= the api's CENTRIFUGO_TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET). Env overrides config, so no placeholder value lives here — a missing env var fail-closes (no valid token, no authorized publish) instead of falling back to a committed default. Same contract as infra/deploy/compose/api-prod/centrifugo/config.json.
//origins: Deliberately ABSENT from this file. The browser origins are the slot's own storefront hosts (academy-<slot>/doctor-<slot>.<STAGE_BASE_DOMAIN>), which differ per slot, so compose.yml supplies them through CENTRIFUGO_CLIENT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Pinning them per slot is what keeps a preview's page from opening a socket against another slot's Centrifugo; the dev-stand's "*" is a dev-only convenience and is NOT used here.
//channel: Identical `room` namespace contract to production and the dev stand (006 EARS-3): clients are subscribed server-side via the token's `channels` claim, can NEVER publish (every post rides the api's gated PostChatMessage over the HTTP API), and may read bounded history to hydrate a mid-webinar join.
